LanguageData.MS_Shelf_ConfigureDesc: Choose three item types and their restocking limits, with at most one stack of each. The shelf restocks about every 4.17 seconds. Reserved stacks are left untouched.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_PriorityHint: Priority affects hauling of existing stock. Colonists will not haul items into this shelf; only the connected storage network provides restocking.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_LimitTip: Restock quantity limit: 0–{0}. Zero pauses restocking for this slot. Lowering the limit keeps existing stock; future restocking uses the new limit after items are taken.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Use: Colonists can take items directly. Restocks automatically; does not accept normal hauling.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_PickHint: Expand categories or search, then click an item to select it. Each slot holds one item type. The three selections must be different.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_AlreadySelected: This item is already assigned to another slot.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_FilterHint: Restock only items matching the quality, condition and material filters. Rejected stock returns to the network where possible, or is placed nearby. Reserved or forbidden stock is left untouched.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_WarnOnFailureTip: Show an alert when a restocking attempt cannot reach the configured quantity. A zero limit or waiting for a colonist to pick up stock does not trigger an alert. Clears when restocking succeeds.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_AlertExplanation: These slots have restocking warnings enabled and could not reach their configured quantities. Alerts clear when restocking succeeds or warnings are disabled.
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_FilterMismatch: No stock matches the quality, condition or material filters
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_ReservedStock: Required stock is reserved by another task and temporarily unavailable
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_IncompatibleStack: Remaining stock cannot stack with the items on the shelf
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_NetworkUnavailable: The storage network cannot operate; check the core and connections
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_NoSpace: No free shelf space, or items cannot be placed in its cell
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_PlacementFailed: Items could not be placed on the shelf
LanguageData.MS_Shelf_Failure_Burning: The shelf cell is on fire and cannot be restocked
